next_action.description: Decide what to do about ref_boost on node 408 of the Krea2 t2i template. Testing showed 4 locks the character's POSE as well as identity and constrains the model, which is wrong for the shared graph that serves every Krea2 edit. Three options are written up in MPI-346/validation.md: sweep for a lower general-purpose value, keep the bake neutral and expose ref_boost as a PromptBox control so identity-lock is opt-in, or leave 4 only on a dedicated identity/character App per MPI-348. Whatever is chosen, the template edit happens in the ComfyUI node graph and is then synced with `node scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs`.

key_decisions: OPEN — ref_boost 4 is the wrong general default. It genuinely locks identity (measured), but follow-up testing showed it also locks POSE and holds the reference too literally to take direction. Node 408 currently bakes 4 in both shipped cards. NOT released (still UNRELEASED.md territory), so there is time. Note the UNRELEASED.md entry claims the model is 'pushed harder to keep the face and features' — revisit that wording if the value changes.

ref_boost applies to the LAST reference only, and its attention-bias rows cover EVERY target token — so on two references it drags character A toward reference B. That is structural, not tuning. Two-ref is baked at 1.0 deliberately.
Krea2 v1.2 WEIGHTS were already shipped on 2026-07-09 while the NODES were still v1.1 — the weights had been running on legacy reference geometry. That mismatch is what this card fixed.

comfyui-inpaint-cropandstitch was removed from the Krea2 cards and given to the Head Swap app. Found by static analysis, never reproduced live; an existing install with Krea2 but not Head Swap now holds an ownerless copy of the pack, which is correct but whose holder-count transition was not exercised.

block_if_empty was turned OFF on Input_Image to unblock t2i. Trade-off: a genuinely missing image on an EDIT run now degrades to a black reference instead of halting. Contained by the Input_Is_i2i / Input_Is_Edit gates.
constraints: EXPORT HAZARD, bit twice this session: a ComfyUI browser tab restores its OWN cached copy of the graph, not the file on disk. Exporting from a tab whose object_info predates a node bump silently drops the new widget values; refreshing then re-adds them at DEFAULTS. ALWAYS diff raw/ against HEAD before running the sync — a green /object_info gate proves the SERVER is current, not that the exporting TAB was. Use Workflow -> Open on the file rather than letting the tab restore.

Before any workflow sync, verify /object_info exposes the new node schema. A running ComfyUI keeps the old module in memory even after its files are replaced — Python does not reload in place, so restart the server after touching custom_nodes.

TWO ComfyUI installs exist: G:/ComfyUi (standalone authoring bench, custom nodes hand-maintained, a node_lock bump does NOT reach it) and engine/ComfyUI_windows_portable (the app's engine, fed by node_lock via the drift ladder). Both are on krea2edit v1.2.2. They compete for port 8188. Identify the live one with `netstat -ano | grep ":8188.*LISTENING"` — note the port precedes the state, so a `LISTENING.*:8188` pattern never matches.

Krea2 dimensions must be multiples of 16 (VAE /8 x DiT patch 2). A /8-but-not-/16 size lands on an odd latent and is CIRCULAR-padded — content wraps in from the opposite edge, generates, then crops back. It runs; one edge is subtly wrong.
fit_mode 'fit' only takes effect when BOTH vae and source_image are connected on the patch node; otherwise it prints a warning and falls back to the latent path.
raw/ is the user's source of truth. No tooling may write there. sync-raw-workflows.mjs commits raw itself, gates on validate-injection-rules.mjs, then leaves generated files staged for close-out.
Kanban board.json is indent=2 with CRLF endings — a read/rewrite with the wrong indent produces a 1000-line diff. Pass encoding='utf-8' and newline='\r\n'.
